description: Candidate argues aggressively that DSA is irrelevant in modern development, writes no code.

transcript.text: Welcome to your interview. Let's look at Coin Change.
Why do companies still ask these useless LeetCode questions? Nobody uses Coin Change in React or Node.
This evaluates problem decomposition and algorithm fundamentals. Can we proceed?
No, this is completely stupid. I build real full-stack web apps with Next.js. I'm not going to write dynamic programming.
If you don't want to solve the problem, we will have to conclude the interview.
Go ahead and end it then.
